gmd:abstract.gco:CharacterString: INSPIRE Download Service for Digital Terrain Model Grid Width 200 m (DGM200). The Digital Terrain Model DGM200 describes the terrain forms of the earth’s surface by means of a point quantity arranged in a regular grid, which is georeferenced to planimetry and altimetry. The grid width is 200 m. The data provided through this service covers the area of Germany. Scale: 1:200000 ; Erläuterung zum Fachbezug: WCS Service
